prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 79.1%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 77.0%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 68.5%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 91.9%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 24.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Pet Control Basics Interactive Sheet: Adds a dedicated quick-start screen at the end of onboarding explaining hotkeys to hide, show, and interact with the pet. (why: 3 support tickets reported confusion post-onboarding regarding how to control, hide, or talk to their new desktop pet.)
1: [home, layout] Desktop Rendering Live Progress Checklist: Rebuilds the waiting screen with a checklist layout indicating desktop render initialization steps. (why: 3 support emails reported pet not appearing on desktop or app failing to open, while home waiting has high mean duration (2336s).)
2: [sign_in, hint] Account Recovery and Sync Disclaimer Banner: Adds explicit sign-in banner copy clarifying that signing in preserves existing pets. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing pets after sign-in.)
3: [adoption, wait_info] Custom Generation Quality Checklist Callout: Displays photo resolution and lighting guidance during custom pet photo upload. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected rendering outcomes.)
4: [finish, copy] Desktop Presence Quick Start Guide Copy: Updates finish headline and body to provide explicit guidance on right-clicking and chatting with the pet. (why: Finish stage drops to 64.8% completion and support receives confusion emails about desktop interactions.)
5: [home, notification] Desktop Ready Tray Sound Alert Prompt: Adds an optional completion chime and notification toggle when pet desktop rendering completes. (why: Waiting step has a long median wait (201s) causing users to lose track of app launch status.)

scores.note: Targeting high drop-off at finish step, but adding a new screen introduces cost and possible friction.
Home step drop-off is low (8.1%), though long wait duration and support tickets support addressing it.
High support ticket count (8 emails) and moderate sign-in step drop; low-cost banner tweak.
Adoption step has significant drop-off (31.5%) and guidance directly addresses generation failures.
Finish stage has the largest funnel drop (35.2%); simple copy update offers low cost and high potential lift.
Addresses long median wait time on home step, but home step already has high overall conversion (91.9%).
